publicProductName.rule: Replace only when the source refers to the named product. Do not replace generic artificial-intelligence terminology.

technicalIdentifiers.rule: Token-aware replacement only. Never replace arbitrary tai substrings inside unrelated words or external immutable identifiers.

compatibility.environment: GEKTA_* is authoritative; TAI_* may be read temporarily as a deprecated fallback with telemetry and a removal owner.
compatibility.http: New /gekta and /api/gekta routes become authoritative; /tai aliases remain temporarily where external consumers exist.
compatibility.clientStorage: Read the new Gekta key first, fall back once to the legacy TAI/assistant key, write only the Gekta key, and remove the legacy key after successful migration.
compatibility.analytics: Emit gekta_* events and map historical tai_* events into one reporting series without rewriting raw history.
compatibility.artifacts: Historical OCI, object-storage, release-evidence and signed artifact identities are immutable and remain allowlisted history.

forbidden: claiming production deployment without REG.RU exact-SHA evidence
